name: Centrifuging
dimensions: triptych, overall: H. 122 x W. 180 cm (48 1/16 x 70 7/8 in.)
summary: Printed triptych mounted as three hanging scrolls showcasing a continuous abstract composition of geometric shapes consist of a black solid circle with thickly saturated ink anchored in far-right middle. Two third of the paper area to the left of the circle is a black almost leaf-shape form with white “cracking” openings along the edges. A gray filled rectangle is situated on the upper left corner of this composition. The circle, the “leaf” form, and the rectangle are not overlapping. Lower left
